title: Column-free plasmid miniprep
author: Vladimir Vigdorovich
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.d7e9jd

steps.title: Harvest cells and resuspend
steps.instruction: Spin the overnight 3 mL E. coli culture at 4,000 rpm in a tabletop centrifuge for ~15 min. Discard the supernatant and vortex the pellet to resuspend it in the residual culture medium.

steps.title: Add Buffer P1
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL Buffer P1 to the resuspended cells and mix by pipetting or vortexing.

steps.title: Add Buffer P2
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL Buffer P2 and mix gently by inverting the tube several times.

steps.title: Add Buffer P3
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL Buffer P3, mix vigorously by inverting/shaking the tube several times (do not vortex). Ensure the viscous solution is thoroughly mixed and allow the flocculant SDS precipitate to form.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at >10,000 rpm in a microcentrifuge for 5 min to remove SDS and cell debris.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer the clarified lysate (~750 µL) to a clean tube containing 750 µL pure isopropanol and mix by inversion.

steps.title: Pellet nucleic acids
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at >10,000 rpm for 5 min in a microcentrifuge to pellet the nucleic acids.

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 500 µL of 70 % ethanol, gently dislodging the pellet from the tube side by shaking.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at >10,000 rpm for 5 min to re‑pellet the nucleic acids.

steps.title: Remove ethanol and dry
steps.instruction: Gently pipette off the ethanol and air‑dry the pellet; if a SpeedVac is available, use it for ~2 min. Do not overdry the pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Dissolve the dried pellet in 50 µL nuclease‑free water.
